btn_install.en: Install the app if you don't have it

hint_1.xh: Ukuskena i-QR ekwisikrini se-RayTok sefowuni enye kukuzisa apha. Ukuba usetyenziso lufakiwe luvuleka ngoko nangoko; ukuba alukho, lufake ngeqhosha elingentla uze uskene i-QR kwakhona.
hint_1.en: Scanning the QR on the other phone's RayTok screen brings you here. If the app is installed it opens right away; if not, install it with the button above and scan the QR again.

hint_2.xh: Zombini iifowuni kufuneka zibe kwi-Wi-Fi enye (okanye i-hotspot yenye). Ayifuneki i-intanethi.
hint_2.en: Both phones must be on the same Wi-Fi (or one phone's hotspot). No internet needed.

hint_3.xh: Ulwazi loqhagamshelo olukwibha yedilesi yidilesi yasekhaya yaloo fowuni nekhowudi yokuqinisekisa esetyenziswa kanye. Alunantsingiselo ngaphandle kwaloo Wi-Fi kwaye luyayeka ukusebenza xa umsingathi evala isikrini.
hint_3.en: The connection info in the address bar is that phone's local address and a one-time verification code. It means nothing unless you're on the same Wi-Fi, and it stops working as soon as the host closes the screen.

msg_no_info.xh: Eli khonkco alinalo ulwazi loqhagamshelo. Nceda uskene kwakhona i-QR ekwesinye isikrini.
msg_no_info.en: This link has no connection info. Please scan the QR on the other screen again.

msg_android.xh: Ukuba usetyenziso lufakiwe luya kuvuleka ngoko nangoko. Ukuba akunjalo, cofa iqhosha elingezantsi.
msg_android.en: If the app is installed it will open right away. If not, tap the button below.

msg_ios.xh: Eli khonkco lelosetyenziso lwe-RayTok lwe-Android. Akukho setyenziso lwe-iPhone okwangoku.
msg_ios.en: This link is for the Android RayTok app. There is no iPhone app yet.
